subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: After live proof or a proof override, should OpenClaw accept a Matrix plugin wrapper around private matrix-js-sdk `cryptoBackend.preprocessToDeviceMessages` for malformed Element SAS accept events?
rationale: The code location matches the observed dependency boundary, but the hook is private and sits in Matrix E2EE device-verification preprocessing, so maintainers need to own that compatibility and upgrade risk.

options.title: Require proof, then accept the hook
options.body: Add redacted live Element/Synapse verification proof from this branch and merge the focused workaround if the proof shows SAS completion.

options.title: Accept with proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override live proof and own the private SDK hook risk for this release.

options.title: Pause for upstream direction
options.body: If private cryptoBackend wrapping is not acceptable, pause this PR and pursue a matrix-js-sdk or Element-side compatibility fix instead.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept the hook
recommendation.body: Add redacted live Element/Synapse verification proof from this branch and merge the focused workaround if the proof shows SAS completion.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest Matrix E2EE and verification history in the central files affected by this private dependency-boundary choice.
